news.title: Northland beat Otago to reach the NPC final
news.summary: Northland beat Otago 38-19 in Whangarei, with Rivez Reihana scoring two tries and 18 points. They will face the Canterbury v Taranaki winner.

news.title: Taranaki's run of 50-point wins sets up Canterbury semi
news.summary: Taranaki became the first NPC side to win four straight games by 50-plus points, and Jacob Ratumaitavuki-Kneepkens says the squad is peaking. Canterbury beat Waikato 62-26 for their sixth win in a row.

news.title: The top performers from the NPC quarter-finals
news.summary: A look back at the quarter-finals. Taranaki, Canterbury, Otago and Northland went through, and Taranaki beat North Harbour 50-31.

news.title: NPC crowds up 57 per cent in 50th season
news.summary: Regular-season crowds rose 57% to more than 300,000, and social media views rose 103%. The season produced 645 tries at an average of 61.6 points a game.

news.title: Counties Manukau retain the Ranfurly Shield against Hawke's Bay
news.summary: Counties won a tight first defence 12-7 at home in Pukekohe to hold the Shield through the off-season.

news.title: Late penalty sees Counties stun Northland to win the Ranfurly Shield
news.summary: Counties Manukau won 22-19 in Whangarei with a 79th-minute penalty to take the Shield from Northland.

news.title: Canterbury v Auckland and Wellington v Northland in FPC finals
news.summary: Canterbury beat Manawatu 57-7 and Auckland Storm beat Waikato 36-31 to set up the Premiership final. Wellington beat Hawke's Bay Tui 51-26 to reach the Championship final.

news.title: Canterbury beat Auckland Storm 50-24 in the FPC Premiership final
news.summary: Canterbury beat Auckland Storm 50-24 in the final at One NZ Stadium. A day earlier, Wellington Pride beat Northland 39-15 in the Championship final.

news.title: 2027 Super Rugby Pacific draw released
news.summary: The 10-team 2027 season starts on 12 February with Crusaders v Reds. The defending champion Hurricanes open at Eden Park against the Blues on 13 February, and the grand final is on 26 June.

news.title: Ardie Savea joins the Blues for 2027
news.summary: The All Blacks captain has signed a one-year deal with the Blues after Moana Pasifika's exit. He is recovering from shoulder surgery.

news.title: Cameron Millar signs with the Blues
news.summary: Otago first-five Cameron Millar leaves the Highlanders after four seasons and joins the Blues on a two-year deal from 2027.

news.title: Hurricanes sign six-time champion Bryn Hall
news.summary: Former Crusaders halfback Bryn Hall has joined the Hurricanes on a one-year deal to back up Cameron Roigard in their title defence.

news.title: Oliver Haig joins the Hurricanes from the Highlanders
news.summary: Loose forward and possible lock Oliver Haig, 24, moves north for the 2027 campaign.

news.title: Roger Randle joins the Hurricanes coaching staff
news.summary: The long-serving Chiefs attack coach replaces Jason Holland, who has left to become Blues head coach in 2027.

news.title: Chiefs sign playmaker Taha Kemara
news.summary: The 23-year-old Waikato NPC first-five has signed a one-year deal for 2027 and returns to his home region.

news.title: Scott Hansen takes over as Crusaders head coach for 2027
news.summary: Rob Penney stepped down after the 2026 season. Former Crusaders halfback and All Blacks assistant Scott Hansen replaces him.

news.title: Highlanders add two international recruits
news.summary: Samoan outside back Tuna Tuitama, formerly of Moana Pasifika, and Fijian lock Joseva Tamani join for 2027.

news.title: Jamie Joseph's off-season plans for 2027
news.summary: Joseph's staff are using the off-season to plan recruitment and recruit more widely, as they compete with overseas clubs for players.

news.title: Moana Pasifika will not play in Super Rugby in 2027
news.summary: NZ Rugby rejected all rescue bids after the club went into liquidation, so 2027 has 10 teams. NZR says it is open to bids for seasons after 2027.
